title: Shanghai Vice: Bund Outlaw
description: Tear through twilight Shanghai along the Bund in a crimson supercar, dodge 6-star police chases, and transform mid-battle into a towering skyline mecha!
controls: WASD move & drive, F hijack/enter vehicle, Right-Click aim, V transform mecha, 5 beam rifle, Tab switch protagonists.

zh-CN.title: 罪恶魔都：外滩狂飙
zh-CN.description: 落日外滩开上红色超跑横冲直撞！6 星警车全城围堵、街头激战飙车，随时还能一键变身巨型机甲横扫魔都天际线。
zh-CN.controls: WASD 移动驾驶，F 抢车互动，鼠标右键瞄准，V 切换机甲形态，5 光束步枪，Tab 切换双主角。
